summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Data Room feature (P0 critical) - Iteration 7. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: seller Data Room tab with Documentos/Permisos/Seguimiento sub-views, upload section with folder/subcategory selectors, file tree, buyer Data Room view with folders and download buttons.

backend: GET /api/dataroom/folders - returns correct folder structure with 7 folders and subcategories
POST /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/upload - seller can upload document to specific folder
GET /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/documents - seller sees all documents grouped by folder
GET /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/permissions - seller sees all buyer permissions
GET /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/documents - buyer with NDA can see documents
PUT /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/permissions/{buyer_id} - seller can set folder-level permissions
GET /api/dataroom/deals/{deal_id}/access-log - contains buyer names, actions, timestamps
frontend: Seller login and redirect to seller dashboard
Deal Management page loads with Data Room tab
Data Room tab shows Documentos/Permisos/Seguimiento sub-navigation
Documentos view shows upload section with folder/subcategory selectors
Documentos view shows file tree with 7 folders (Financiero, Legal, Fiscal, Comercial, Operaciones, Equipo, Otros)
Permisos view shows buyer permissions with folder-level access control
Permisos view shows 'Acceso completo' badge for full access buyers
Seguimiento view shows access tracking with buyer names, actions, timestamps
Seguimiento view shows action labels in Spanish (Visualizó, Descargó, Accedió al Data Room)
Buyer with NDA sees 'NDA Firmado' badge on deal page
Buyer with NDA sees DataRoomBuyerView component
DataRoomBuyerView shows folder structure with document count
DataRoomBuyerView shows download buttons for each document
DataRoomBuyerView shows file details (name, size, subcategory)
